evidence.api_compatibility: No API changes. No code was modified. No schema, protocol, config contract, CLI command, or persistence format was altered. The mkdocs.yml site_url change is a documentation build configuration, not a runtime or API contract.

It adds a new 'Links' subsection to docs/dev/documentation.md establishing a convention: use relative Markdown paths with .md extensions for in-repo links, and use explicit GitHub URLs for repository-only files outside docs/. It fixes 16 files of broken or stale links. The PR description clearly explains the problem (pre-release website not yet deployed → 404s) and the solution (relative paths that follow the branch/tag, and correct /docs/ base for published docs).

The mkdocs.yml change alters the published docs base path from / to /docs/. A reviewer should verify: (1) the README links on GitHub resolve to the correct .md files in the repo; (2) the mkdocs site builds and serves at https://lemonade-server.ai/docs/ with all internal links resolving.
